payload.name: Greatest Labyrinth
payload.description: Pulls all players to the middle of the room. Spawns green arrows in different directions on the arena tiles (except for the middle 4 squares), purple X symbols on three corners, and a blue O symbol on one corner tile. Each player will receive link= Greatest Curse that lasts for 15s. They must cleanse this debuff before it naturally expires or they will instantly die. To cleanse the debuff, players must use the green arrows to transport them to the corner O tile. Touching the X tiles will inflict poison poison, dealing high damage-over-time. The symbols will disappear after the mechanic resolves. The easiest way to solve this is to locate the blue O tile corner work backwards, following the arrows that point to it until they reach the center of the room to find the safe path. Once you have reached the blue O tile, you may safely return to the center of the labyrinth and start attacking the boss once more, without waiting for the maze to disappear.

payload.name: Spirited Charge
payload.description: The dolls will begin running through the arena, aiming at certain players. Once each doll reaches the other side, it will run through the arena a second time. Anyone who touches them will be inflicted with bind for 5s, making them vulnerable to subsequent avoidable AoEs, and then inflicted with File:Benoggined icon.png Benoggined for 10s. This attack is combined with other mechanics throughout the fight, causing a very chaotic sequence of dodging multiple AoEs and dolls at once. The first time the dolls move, they will aim for the furthest player from them. The second time they move, they will aim for the closest player. Two ranged players can bait the dolls by standing near the north and south side of the arena, then move clockwise to dodge until the dolls reach the opposite wall. The dolls should aim for them again, so they can now dodge towards the middle of the arena.

payload.name: Troubling Teacups
payload.description: Now spawns eight teacups, two per cardinal. Tea Awhirl: Two teacups will now be possessed by ghosts. Similar to before, players must keep track of where the possessed teacups end up because both of them will explode. The two tethered teacups will either be 90 or 180 degrees apart, so the final set of AoEs will also spawn in the safe offset. An easy solution to this mechanic is to observe just the first teacup (if possessed cups are next to each other) or any of them if they are on opposite sides. When the cups start to stop go 90 degrees ahead of the observed cup (where another, safe cup will be present) on the edge of the encounter area.

payload.name: Toiling Teapots
payload.description: Spawns 13 teacups, nine on the cardinals/center and four on the intercardinals. Kettles will appear over some cups and begin pouring a purple liquid into them, causing them to overflow and create an expanding puddle AoE. While these expand, more cups will be filled and overflow to create more puddles, followed by the remaining cups. Anyone who contacts a puddle will receive damage (Mad Tea Party) and be inflicted with bleeding damage-over-time for 15s. Players should stand near the cups to be filled last and move into the previous puddle locations when they disappear. The boss will use Last Drop, a telegraphed magical tankbuster, during this.
